headlines.description: Deshaun Watson threw two touchdown passes to DeAndre Hopkins and finished with 298 yards to help the Houston Texans beat the Indianapolis Colts 20-17 on Thursday night to take the AFC South lead.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hopkins has 2 TDs, Texans beat Colts 20-17 to top AFC South

events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at Atlanta Falcons

headlines.description: Massive defensive lineman Vita Vea turned receiver to haul in his first career touchdown, one of three scoring throws by Jameis Winston as the Tampa Bay Buccaneers escaped last place in the NFC South with a 35-22 rout of the Atlanta Falcons on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Big guy, big catch: Vea TD leads Bucs past Falcons 35-22

headlines.description: Josh Allen threw two touchdowns passing and Shaq Lawson had two of Buffalo's four sacks in a 20-3 win over the Denver Broncos on Sunday that has the Bills off to their best start in 23 years.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bills improve to 8-3 following 20-3 win over Broncos

events.name: New York Giants at Chicago Bears

headlines.description: Khalil Mack set up a touchdown with a strip-sack, Allen Robinson had a season-high 131 yards receiving and the Chicago Bears beat the struggling New York Giants 19-14 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mack, Robinson lead Bears to 19-14 win over Giants

headlines.description: Devlin “Duck” Hodges took over for struggling Mason Rudolph and threw a 79-yard touchdown pass Sunday, sparking the depleted Pittsburgh Steelers to a 16-10 victory that kept the Cincinnati Bengals the only winless team in the NFL.
headlines.shortLinkText: Duck Time: Hodges leads Steelers over winless Bengals 16-10

headlines.description: Jarvis Landry caught two touchdown passes against his former team and the Cleveland Browns won their third straight Sunday, 41-24 over the Miami Dolphins in their first game since losing star defensive end Myles Garrett to a season-ending suspension.
headlines.shortLinkText: Browns rout Dolphins 41-24 in first game since Garrett mess

events.name: Carolina Panthers at New Orleans Saints

headlines.description: Wil Lutz kicked a 33-yard field goal as time expired, and the New Orleans Saints beat the Carolina Panthers 34-31 on Sunday to take a four-game lead in the NFC South with five games left.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lutz’s kick lifts Saints to dramatic 34-31 win over Panthers

events.name: Oakland Raiders at New York Jets

headlines.description: Sam Darnold threw two touchdown passes and ran for another score, leading the New York Jets to an impressive 34-3 victory over the Oakland Raiders on Sunday for their first three-game winning streak in over two years.
headlines.shortLinkText: Darnold leads Jets to third straight win, 34-3 over Raiders

headlines.description: Rashaad Penny ran for a career-best 129 yards, including a 58-yard touchdown, Russell Wilson threw one TD pass and the Seattle Seahawks beat the Philadelphia Eagles 17-9 Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Penny runs for 129 yards, Seahawks beat Eagles 17-9

headlines.description: Quinton Dunbar intercepted Jeff Driskel in the final minute, Dustin Hopkins hit the go-ahead field goal from 39 yards out with 16 seconds left and the Washington Redskins beat the Detroit Lions 19-16 Sunday to snap a four-game losing streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Redskins come back to beat Lions for 2nd win of season

headlines.description: The Tennessee Titans scored four touchdowns over six offensive plays in the third quarter, routing the Jacksonville Jaguars 42-20 Sunday for their second straight victory to keep themselves firmly in the AFC playoff hunt.
headlines.shortLinkText: Titans explode for 4 TDs in 6 plays, rout Jaguars 42-20

events.name: Dallas Cowboys at New England Patriots

headlines.description: Tom Brady threw a touchdown pass and the Patriots' defense held the Cowboys' top-ranked offense without a TD for the first time this season as New England beat Dallas 13-9 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pats hold Cowboys' No. 1 offense without TD in 13-9 win

events.name: Green Bay Packers at San Francisco 49ers

headlines.description: Jimmy Garoppolo threw two long touchdown passes and the San Francisco harassed Aaron Rodgers all night, leading the 49ers to a 37-8 victory over the Green Bay Packers on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: 49ers start 3-game gauntlet with 37-8 win over Packers

events.name: Baltimore Ravens at Los Angeles Rams

headlines.description: Lamar Jackson matched his career high with five touchdown passes and ran for 95 yards in another splendid all-around performance, and the Baltimore Ravens routed the Los Angeles Rams 45-6 on Monday night for their seventh consecutive victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lamar Jackson throws 5 TD passes, Ravens rout Rams 45-6
